accueil.vide: No characters yet. Create the first one, then open your book at section 1.
fiche.introuvable: This character does not exist on this device.
reglages.sauvegarde_aide: Your characters stay on this device. Export them from time to time: the file lets you recover them on another device or after the browser is cleared.
reglages.import_erreur: This file is not a readable Fabled Lands Helper backup.
reglages.import_recent: This backup comes from a newer version of the app: update the app, then try again.
installation.texte: Once installed, it opens from the home screen like an app and works without a network.
installation.geste: Open the browser menu (⋮), then choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen". On iPhone and iPad: the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
installation.installee: The app is installed on this device.
maj.a_jour: The app is up to date.
maj.telechargement: A new version is downloading: it will be offered to you in a moment.
maj.impossible: Cannot check without a network. Try again once you are online.
stockage.bloque: The browser is blocking storage: characters cannot be kept on this device. Leave private browsing or allow this site's data, then reopen the app.
apropos.outil: Fabled Lands Helper is a free, unofficial fan tool. It accompanies the printed book without replacing it: it contains no section text, no maps and no illustrations from the books.
apropos.oeuvre: Fabled Lands is a gamebook series by Dave Morris and Jamie Thomson. The French edition is published by Alkonost.
apropos.sources: The adventure sheet labels, the list of codewords and the list of tick-box sections follow the adventure booklet of the French edition, freely downloadable from Alkonost's website. All rights to this material remain with its authors and publisher.
apropos.polices: Typefaces: IM Fell English SC (Igino Marini) and Alegreya (Huerta Tipográfica), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
apropos.donnees: Your characters stay on this device: the app sends nothing over the Internet.
nouveau.libre_aide: Copy the starting values from your book. Everything can be changed later from the sheet.
pretire.source: The pre-generated characters for books 1 and 2, published by Alkonost. Their portrait and story are on the publisher's page.
feuille.histoire_aide: Your notes on the character: they stay on this device.
feuille.possessions_plein: Twelve possessions at most: remove one to take another.
apropos.pretires: The pre-generated characters use the starting scores and possessions from the sheets Alkonost publishes for books 1 and 2: six characters by Dave Morris and Jamie Thomson, and three created for the French edition. Their portrait and story stay on the publisher's page. All rights in these characters remain with their authors and the publisher.
pretire.consigne: Tap a character to choose it; its name and the "Create" button will appear here.
installation.raccourci: If the icon does not appear on the home screen, check in the device settings that your browser is allowed to create home screen shortcuts, then try again.
